verdict.rationale: The evidence shows piecemeal retrieval paths for a user's records. Uncertified patent copies can be downloaded (uspto-docs-20). Filed trademark documents appear in the TSDR document retrieval system (uspto-docs-33). Registered users can view their submissions (uspto-docs-16). An API-keyed machine surface exists for viewing applications (uspto-supp-3, uspto-probe-4). Some of these documents use open formats such as TIFF and PDF (uspto-docs-13, uspto-docs-12). Missing for 10: any documented account-wide 'export all my data' function, explicit open-format bulk export of account data such as docket, payment and correspondence history, keyless-readable API documentation (uspto-probe-5), and independent or hands-on confirmation that a complete export works.
